data.title: Bessent: Iran can't pay its soldiers, proxies due to Operation Economic Outcast | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The operation, which was announced August 24, aims to cut Tehran's funding for the war, missile construction, cyberattacks, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).
